title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2050 South Boulevard in Bloomfield Township, Michigan, as the "Dr. Ezra S. Parke Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2050 South Boulevard in Bloomfield Township, Michigan, as the Dr. Ezra S. Parke Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Michigan post office building in Bloomfield Township after Dr. Ezra S. Parke.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2050 South Boulevard in Bloomfield Township, Michigan, the Dr. Ezra S. Parke Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation took effect at that time.
